source_count_annotation: Probe inherits the old scope sentence saying Eight subsequent frame requests. The executable loop, preregistration, corpus and counts have 33 frames per sequence; this receipt corrects that prose without rewriting the retained result.
semantics: Full 707370 recomposes world from previous local before 8978D0. Each small step updates local while mask 0 suppresses 4E2160 reference publication; after 32 steps the reference/root X distance exceeds .1. A larger final step produces mask 1 and exact current-root reference coordinates.
boundaries: Null native World and null cell/config skip broadphase/activation/migration; allocations/free, command extraction/nonactor RTTI, Windows imports/TLS/critical sections and change marks retain prior declared boundaries. Not actual full game frame dispatch or gameplay.
runtime_relevance: Natural Recoil runtime verifier02 incorrectly asserted absolute saved-reference/root closeness<=.01 after moving-body restart. Existing C++ uses original per-frame masks. The original2112-case proof and exact saved-reference load check justify replacing that invariant; failed verifier02 retained. No engine change or new gameplay acceptance from this oracle alone.
